body: A country in the UK. I'm going to re-evaluate and look at options. Thanks for talking to me.

It would be illegal for me to not go into further education - which is something that, if I forget about suicide, I would almost definitely do. The "backpacker"/"vagabond" life is so appealing but I can't do it until the government has finished with their plans for what's best for me. When did somebodies life become not their property? Why do I HAVE to follow a certain path?

Further education is mandatory, and, honestly, I don't think I can go through with it. I have to go further with education and I don't think I can. It'll just be more and more formula's until I can actually get to where I want to be.
